title: dividend-settlement/1
description: The Commonwealth's instruction to a State: the per-person dividend and total for one period. total must equal per_person times recipients.

basis.description: id of the eligibility-count/1 record this settlement is based on.

unit.description: Unit of account, three uppercase letters.

amount.description: Non-negative decimal amount: up to 18 digits before the point and 6 after, no sign, exponent or leading zeros. Compared by value.
